explorer.examples.fork-join.guide.fork: loadPage spawns loadHeader and loadSidebar as parallel processes.
explorer.examples.fork-join.guide.join: loadPage waits for both spawned process results, then returns the combined page data.
explorer.examples.fork-join.title: Fork-Join
explorer.examples.future-settlement.guid: receiveSmsCode settles smsCode with the received code.
verifyPhoneNumber waits on smsCode until receiveSmsCode provides the value.
explorer.examples.scope-boundary.guide.e: publishArticle runs commitArticle inside enclose and later returns the enclosed result.
explorer.examples.scope-boundary.guide.s: enclose creates a child scope that owns work spawned inside the boundary.
commitArticle produces published before updateSearchIndex finishes, but enclose waits for owned work before returning.
explorer.examples.scope-boundary.title: Scope Ownership
explorer.examples.single-spawn.guide.par: submitOrder returns order accepted while sendReceiptEmail is still running.
explorer.examples.single-spawn.guide.spa: submitOrder spawns sendReceiptEmail as a new process and keeps moving.
explorer.examples.single-spawn.title: Single Spawn
